Write a Python function `is_balanced(s: str) -> bool` that returns True if every bracket in s (only the characters ()[]{} matter; ignore all other characters) is properly opened and closed.

tasks.prompt:
Write a Python function `top_k_words(words: list[str], k: int) -> list[str]` that returns the k most frequent words, ordered by frequency descending, ties broken alphabetically ascending.

Return the complete function in a single ```python code block. No tests, no I/O.

grader.tests:
assert top_k_words(['a','b','a','c','b','a'], 2) == ['a','b']
assert top_k_words(['x','y','z','y','x'], 3) == ['x','y','z']
assert top_k_words(['pear','apple','pear','apple','fig'], 1) == ['apple']
assert top_k_words([], 0) == []
